manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the stapler with white loading section and place it on the electronicscale with gold round platform.

Task description: The target is the blue stapler on the right side of the image with a white staple mechanism. Place it on the gold circular weighing platform of the electronic scale at the lower left.

Success criteria: The stapler is on the gold circular weighing platform, near its center and at a height supported by the platform; the right gripper is open and has released it.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above and grasp relatively straight middle sides across the stapler's long axis. Place pads against the solid body or base to reduce slipping from grasping only the movable lid.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected grasp point. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of the body with enough contact area, rather than pressing only on the top or hitting the table.
- When moving or reorienting near the scale, leave enough height for the stapler base and fingertips to clear the platform edge, avoiding a lateral brush that could shift the scale.
- During placement, let the stapler base rest steadily on the scale before releasing, and leave room for the fingers to open. Avoid releasing it unsupported or tipping it by hitting the scale with the fingertips.
